title: Story premise ENT094: The Elevator Button Courtesy Loop
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (everyday microdramas). Hook: After you. After you. Still after you. Takeaway/theme: A tiny explicit choice can resolve excessive politeness.
description: Two neighbors each insist the other should choose the destination first, leaving a toy lift motionless through an elaborate polite exchange. One draws two floor numbers on a card, both point to the same number, and they press it together before bowing themselves almost out of the frame.
